title: ALPR search audit records, April 2026–present — fixed export ahead of June 4 chief meeting
summary:
Asks for a produced copy of the Department's ALPR search audit records — the per-search Flock audit log entries the system generates — for April 1, 2026 through the date of production, in the same exported form previously produced under W012541-041426 (machine-readable CSV, including all data fields).

Framed as time-sensitive: the requester has a June 4, 2026 meeting with Chief Barberini and wants the records in advance so the meeting can discuss them rather than collect them. The request acknowledges this period partially overlaps with the monthly audit logs SMPD already produces on a rolling basis under the separate, ongoing W012541, but is submitted as a new request because (a) W012541's rolling coverage does not span this entire period and (b) the two most recent months are wanted ahead of the regular monthly cadence for the June 4 meeting. It is directed at the remainder not already produced.

Notes that SMPD recently enabled the public search audit on its Flock transparency page; because that page is a live display that changes over time rather than a fixed export, the request seeks a complete, fixed, authentic copy for review at the meeting.

policy_promises.quote: the agency shall make the information available in the electronic format in which it holds the information
policy_promises.tests: Will SMPD produce a fixed, machine-readable CSV export of the April–present search audit records — the same form it already generates and recently made public — rather than directing the requester to the live transparency page?

policy_promises.quote: an audit is conducted of ALPR data searches at least monthly
policy_promises.tests: Does the produced per-search audit log for April–present match the volume and fields shown on the transparency page and previously produced under W012541?

prior_pra_refs.note: Named in the request as the format precedent ('the same exported form ... for example, in response to W012541'). W012541 is also the separate, ongoing rolling monthly audit CSV production this request overlaps with; W012818 is directed at the April-2026–present remainder not yet produced under it, with the two most recent months wanted ahead of the rolling cadence.

Portal timestamps, June 3, 2026: this request's production message (the April and May Flock search-audit exports) posted at 6:04 PM; eighteen minutes later, at 6:22 PM, W012789 — a single-record request for the same platform's search-audit export with compliance columns included and populated values redacted — was told the report 'does not exist as a record maintained by the Department or within the Flock platform' and is exempt under § 7923.600, § 7922.000, and Evid. Code § 1040.

filed_because: Asks for a fixed, authentic CSV copy of the April 2026–present ALPR search audit records ahead of a June 4 meeting with Chief Barberini, rather than relying on the live transparency-page display SMPD recently enabled.
notes: Filed 2026-05-30; closed 2026-06-03, ahead of both the June 4 chief meeting and the 2026-06-09 statutory due date. SMPD produced the April 2026 and May 2026 monthly ALPR search-audit PDF exports — the two most recent months requested ahead of the rolling W012541 cadence.
